acceptanceCriteria: After successful migration a run_log row records schema_version=2
Re-running migration when schema_version=2 is already present is a no-op (no DDL executed)

userStories.title: Backup DB before migration; non-zero exit on partial failure
acceptanceCriteria: Before any DDL runs, the live DB file is copied to a timestamped backup path
If any migration step fails, process exits with non-zero code
Failure message prints the absolute path of the backup file
DB is never left in a half-migrated state (transaction rolled back or restored from backup)

Tests pass
